title: Afsous Nabi Zaadiyoun ka Shaam mein jaana Sajjad sey poocho
body:
Afsous Nabi Zaadiyoun ka Shaam mein jaana Sajjad sey poocho
Sar nangay woh Maa behnoun ka darbaar mein jaana
Sajjad sey poocho
<<DIVIDER>>
Chhuptee thi Nabi zaadi Nabi zaadi kay peechay
Kis sharm-o-hayaa sey
Aur shimr ka un bibiyoun kay naam bathaana
Sajjad sey poocho
<<DIVIDER>>
Thi ek rasan baaraa Aseeron kay galay thay
Sab chupkay khaday thay
Rassi mein bandhey Zainab-o-Kulsoom ka aana
Sajjad sey poocho
<<DIVIDER>>
Sar Hazrat-e-Muslim ka lataktaa thaa jahaan par
Wahan Sheh ka ruka sar
Durray sitham eejaad ka uss waqt lagaana
Sajjad sey poocho
<<DIVIDER>>
Durr chheenay Sakina kay tamaachey bhi lagaaye
Kis zulmo jafaa sey
Ghurbath mein sithamgaaron ka Sakina ko sathaana
Sajjad sey poocho
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab Baali Sakina ko ghusal deytay thay Sajjad
Faryaad hai faryaad
Uss nanhee si gardan pey nishaan rassi kay paanaa
Sajjad sey poocho
<<DIVIDER>>
Baitthey huvey sab kursiyon par chotay baday thay
Saadaath khaday thay
Sar tasht mein rakkha huvaa Zainab ko dikhaana
Sajjad sey poocho
<<DIVIDER>>
Ghash khaakay giray Syed-e-Sajjad zameen par
Barpaa huvaa mehshar
Naizey ki anee sey unhein uss waqt utthaanaa
Sajjad sey poocho
